notes: The ternary-secret scaling increases determinant by σ^n. For binary secrets the source uses scaling 2σ plus recentering. First posted December 2013 and published ACISP 2014; this record conservatively dates the fully checked revised PDF.

extra.parameters: Fix n,m,q and Gaussian error standard deviation σ; ternary secret for the displayed determinant; d=m+n.
extra.noise: Independent discrete Gaussian error, standard deviation σ; no fixed universal σ(n) is assumed.
extra.secret: Uniform ternary {−1,0,1}^n for displayed formula; binary {0,1}^n uses (2σ)^n determinant factor and recentering.
extra.samples: m available samples; source may discard rows. For ternary scaling, optimized d≈√(n(log₂q−log₂σ)/log₂δ) if allowed by m.
extra.model: ISIS embedding, rescaling, then CVP/uSVP decoding; displayed gap uses the Gaussian heuristic.
extra.assumptions: Random-lattice Gaussian heuristic and reduction-success model.
extra.success: Model-dependent recovery; experiments do not establish an arbitrary-lattice guarantee.

evidence.locator: §§6.1–6.2, pp. 10–11, determinant scaling, gap discussion, Lemma 1 and Eq. (6)
evidence.sourceVersion: Full ePrint version last revised 21 February 2017; first ePrint 16 December 2013; ACISP 2014
